english.title: Aircraft commander / tug-driver fail to stop / give name / address / report accident at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[being the commander]_
(B)_[being the tug-driver]_

of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..) at Stansted Airport when an accident involving the aircraft had occurred at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) you failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the person who was the operator of the aircraft at the time of the accident, the identification marks of the aircraft, and details of the accident to a constable through the published airport telephone number as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(3)(a) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
